THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

Good communication starts with understanding people.

I’m a Mass Communication student at Kwara State University with a growing focus on public relations, marketing strategy and brand communication. I also completed ALX’s 12-month Software Engineering Programme, specializing in front-end development.

I’m building practical experience across broadcast marketing, social media, content and online communities. My work includes reported audience growth for Lasustech Got Talent and the KWASU ICT Bootcamp 1.0 WhatsApp community.

Thoughtful work. Clear stories. Real connection.
